       COALESCE(table_type, '-') AS table_type,

            ELSE concat(CAST(days_since_last_write AS STRING), ' days ago') END AS last_write,

datasets.name: 89ed2450
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'storage_target_table_discovery', 'Table discovery', 'Tables'),
       (1, 'table_inventory_type', 'Table inventory by type', 'Tables'),
       (2, 'access_dead_table_candidates', 'Tables not read or changed recently', 'Tables'),
       (3, 'storage_growth', 'Table growth and drops', 'Tables')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

datasets.name: 6248ff16
queryLines:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.po_maintenance_cost_by_table t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))),
     f AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.po_failure_reasons t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT (SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(estimated_dbu), 0), 0) FROM r) AS value,
       concat(CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(failed_operations), 0) FROM f) AS STRING), ' ops failed outright; worst: ',
              COALESCE((SELECT concat(full_name, ', ', CAST(ROUND(s, 0) AS STRING), ' DBU')
                        FROM (SELECT concat(catalog_name, '.', schema_name, '.', table_name) AS full_name,
                                     SUM(estimated_dbu) AS s FROM r GROUP BY 1
                              ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1) x), 'none')) AS target

WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.po_vacuum_reclaimed_bytes t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT table_name) FROM r WHERE status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN')) AS value,
       concat(CAST((SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(vacuum_estimated_dbu), 0), 1) FROM r WHERE status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN')) AS STRING),
              ' DBU on zero-reclaim VACUUMs') AS target

datasets.name: 9555d8d7
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'po_maintenance_cost_by_table', 'Maintenance spend by table', 'Maintenance'),
       (1, 'po_vacuum_reclaimed_bytes', 'Storage reclaimed by VACUUM', 'Maintenance'),
       (2, 'po_clustering_activity', 'Liquid clustering activity', 'Maintenance'),
       (3, 'po_clustering_column_churn', 'Clustering column changes', 'Maintenance'),
       (4, 'po_data_skipping_backfill', 'Data-skipping statistics backfill', 'Maintenance'),
       (5, 'po_failure_reasons', 'Predictive optimization failures', 'Maintenance'),
       (6, 'storage_po_coverage', 'Predictive optimization coverage', 'Maintenance'),
       (7, 'storage_small_files', 'Tables with too many small files', 'Maintenance')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

datasets.name: 7ec73429
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(concat(n_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS `workspace_shown`,
  t.`status` AS `status`,
  t.`account_id` AS `account_id`,
  t.`metastore_name` AS `metastore_name`,
  t.`catalog_name` AS `catalog_name`,
  t.`schema_name` AS `schema_name`,
  t.`table_id` AS `table_id`,
  t.`table_name` AS `table_name`,
  t.`operation_type` AS `operation_type`,
  t.`operation_status` AS `operation_status`,
  t.`usage_unit` AS `usage_unit`,
  t.`operation_count` AS `operation_count`,
  t.`estimated_dbu` AS `estimated_dbu`,
  date_format(t.`first_op_time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `first_op_time`,
  date_format(t.`last_op_time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `last_op_time`
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.po_maintenance_cost_by_table t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) n_workspace
  ON n_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(n_workspace.n, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY CASE `status` WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 WHEN 'OK' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, `estimated_dbu` DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000

  t.`added_data_skipping_columns` AS `added_data_skipping_columns`,
  t.`removed_data_skipping_columns` AS `removed_data_skipping_columns`,
  t.`new_data_skipping_columns` AS `new_data_skipping_columns`,
  t.`scanned_bytes` AS `scanned_bytes`,
  t.`scanned_files` AS `scanned_files`,
  date_format(t.`last_event_time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `last_event_time`
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.po_data_skipping_backfill t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) n_workspace
  ON n_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(n_workspace.n, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY CASE `status` WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 WHEN 'OK' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, `scanned_bytes` DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000
